N° 14Civic guide2026

How to use Cameroun Citoyen

For voters, students, journalists and members of the diaspora who want to understand Cameroonian parties, elections and institutions from dated sources, and for anyone who wants to raise a local problem with the right official.

Open Cameroun Citoyen ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to cameroun-citoyen.vercel.app.

2

Click Découvrir mes convictions and answer the 24 questions, marking how much each topic matters.

3

Read your agreements and disagreements with each party, then open the party files and their sources.

4

Open Élections for the proclaimed results and, in a separate tab, the contestations.

5

In Ma circonscription, choose your region to see who does what, then prepare a letter.

02

Features

01

Citizen profile

24 situations on work, care, power, freedoms, land and the control of elected officials. Each answer can be weighted. The score measures closeness on documented topics only; it is not a voting instruction.

STEPS

  1. Answer or skip each question
  2. Set how much it matters
  3. Save and resume later
02

Parties

14 party files with positions drawn from their own texts, marked when still to be sourced. Select up to three to compare.

STEPS

  1. Search a party
  2. Tick up to three
  3. Open the file and its sources
03

Elections

Results as proclaimed, with registered voters, valid votes and turnout; polling stations, contestations and reforms in their own tabs. Results can be exported.

STEPS

  1. Choose an election
  2. Read the table and its source
  3. Export the results
04

Ten regions

An artistic 3D atlas of the ten regions, opening onto landscapes, cultures and a musical pause. It is not an official map of borders or communities.

STEPS

  1. Pick a region
  2. Pause the animation
  3. Go on to your constituency
05

My constituency

10 regions, 58 departments and 360 subdivisions. For each level, the role of governor, prefect, sub-prefect, deputies, mayor, councillors and traditional authorities, with a letter to prepare.

STEPS

  1. Choose your region and subdivision
  2. Document a problem
  3. Prepare a letter
06

Courses, books and library

Short courses with examples and exercises, books and essays to read in full, and a library of programmes, official texts, archives, articles and videos, each with its original document. PDFs can be imported and converted.

STEPS

  1. Open a course
  2. Filter the library by type
  3. Import a PDF
03Tips
  • A score shows closeness on documented topics, not the quality of a party. Read the sources behind each match.
  • A headline is a way in: open the article, check its date and cross-check before sharing.
  • Administrative subdivisions, communes, electoral districts and chiefdoms are not the same areas.
04FAQ
Is it linked to a party?

No. It is an independent guide. Party positions come from their own texts, and the questionnaire gives no voting instruction.

Are my answers shared?

No party receives them. Origin, religion and region are not used.

Do I need an account?

No. Reading and the questionnaire are open without an account or payment.

What is still to come?

Contributions, the AI assistant and donations. Until then, nothing is sent from the site.

Which languages?

French and English.
